s: reprimand, censure (accusation of wrongdoing or misbehavior, but typically without further punishment)
Rüge.et: Inherited from Middle High German rüege. Cognate with Old English wrōht, Gothic 𐍅𐍂𐍉𐌷𐍃 (wrōhs).

s: Rügen (an island of the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, located in the Baltic Sea; the largest island of Germany)
to reprimand, to criticize (to convey one's disapproval of someone due to their behavior, often formally but without further consequences)
rügen.et: From Middle High German rüegen, from Old High German ruogen, from Proto-Germanic *wrōgijaną.
